## OUR INGREDIENTS

### What’s on the inside is what matters the most.

Of course, the quality of ingredients has a huge impact on how our products work. But we go beyond “the best” and “the rare”. We like our ingredients to be as natural and fresh as possible, just like the conversations we like to have.

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Medical%20Plants/8850/image-thumb__8850__galleryCarousel/110-Chitrak.2e818fa4.jpg)\\
\\
**Chitrak**\\
\\
A profusely branched perennial shrub with alternate leaves. The plant is available throughout India wildly and is also cultivated in gardens for its brilliant inflorescence. Root and root bark of the plant are used in preparation of various Ayurvedic medi](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/chitrak-plant)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/428/image-thumb__428__galleryCarousel/Varun-Plant.f865709c.jpg)\\
\\
**Varun plant**\\
\\
A moderate sized deciduous tree found wild but also cultivated throughout India. Bark of the tree is used in Ayurveda.](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/varun-plant)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/429/image-thumb__429__galleryCarousel/Tamalpatra.703bd471.jpg)\\
\\
**tamalpatra**\\
\\
A moderate sized tree with aromatic leaves and bark found growing wild in tropical and subtropical Himalayas and north-eastern Himalayas.](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/tamalpatra-plant)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/430/image-thumb__430__galleryCarousel/Shalai-Guggal.2a751ba6.jpg)\\
\\
**shalai guggal**\\
\\
A middle-sized tree with alternate deciduous sessile leaves. It is found in the forests of western and central India. Gum resin from the stem is used medicinally.](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/shalai-guggal)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/1629/image-thumb__1629__galleryCarousel/Pippali%201.7a97e371.jpg)\\
\\
**PIPPALI PLANT**\\
\\
A slender aromatic climber having flowers in solitary spikes forming small red berries sunken in solid fleshy spike. The spike is tremendously used in Ayurveda for the preparation of number of formulations.](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/pippali-plant)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/1630/image-thumb__1630__galleryCarousel/Mulethi%20%281%29.66ec9f00.jpg)\\
\\
**MULETHI**\\
\\
A hardy leguminous undershrub attaining the height of about 3 meter with compressed pods. It is found growing wild in many Asian countries and is also cultivated at small scales in India, Iran, Afghanistan etc. The root tastes sweet and is used in Ayurvedic.](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/mulethi)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/1631/image-thumb__1631__galleryCarousel/Kulanjan%20Plant_0.36d76d89.jpg)\\
\\
**KULANJAN PLANT**\\
\\
Greater galangal grows to a height of 1.8 m and has long, elegant, blade-like leaves. The flowers are green and white with red tips. Rhizome is built up from cylindrical subunits (circular cross-section), whose pale-reddish surface is characteristicall](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/kulanjan-plant)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/1632/image-thumb__1632__galleryCarousel/Jimikand.bf0aeb16.jpg)\\
\\
**JIMIKAND PLANT**\\
\\
A tuberous, stout, indigenous herb, 1.0-1.5 m found almost throughout India. Tubers depressed, globose or hemispherical, dark brown out side, pale dull brown, sometimes almost white, with numerous long roots; leaves solitary, tripartite, 30-90 cm broad](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/jimikand-plant)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/1633/image-thumb__1633__galleryCarousel/Dalchini%20%281%29.28ea629d.jpg)\\
\\
**DALCHINI PLANT**\\
\\
A small evergreen tree with aromatic bark of about 6-8 m in height found growing wild in southern coastal regions of India. The bark is used as culinary spice and also in medicines.](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/dalchini-plant)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/1635/image-thumb__1635__galleryCarousel/Bhojpatra.800f9dba.jpg)\\
\\
**BHOJPATRA PLANT**\\
\\
A moderate sized tree with papery brownish-white bark found in groups at timberline in Himalayas. The thin layers of bark are used in Ayurveda.](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/bhojpatra-plant)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/1634/image-thumb__1634__galleryCarousel/Atees_0.34a11f04.jpg)\\
\\
**ATEES**\\
\\
A perennial erect herb with greenish-blue flower found wild in alpine and sub-alpine Himalayas. Root of the herb is used in Ayurveda.](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/atees)

[![](https://www.dabur.com/Slider/1636/image-thumb__1636__galleryCarousel/Amla%20%281%29.21af8d46.jpg)\\
\\
**AMLA**\\
\\
A middle sized deciduous tree with green globose fruits found wild throughout tropical India. The tree is extensively cultivated these days in many parts of India for its fruits.](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda/ayurvedic-medicinal-plants/amla)

### The only way to care for your body, is to know how to understand it.

According to the [science of Ayurveda](https://www.dabur.com/ayurveda-and-science "science of Ayurveda"), our world is made up of five elements - ether, water, air, earth, and fire. Each of us contains a unique blend of these elements, or doshas - [vata](https://www.dabur.com/blog/doshas/what-vata-dosha "vata"), [pitta](https://www.dabur.com/blog/doshas/what-pitta-dosha "pitta") and [kapha](https://www.dabur.com/blog/doshas/what-kapha-dosha "kapha"). The key to health and wellness lies in balancing the three.
